cells.quote: “The 3PLM was ultimately chosen, which did not have a significant difference with 1PLM and additionally incorporated a guessing parameter compared to the 1PLM.”
cells.note: This contrast is reported in the wiki entry; the supplied study-text excerpt does not include the sentence reporting the pairwise 3PLM-versus-1PLM comparison.

cells.quote: "the total scores of the 50-item scale for each student were negatively correlated with the number of Guttman errors (p = 1.51 × 10− 22)"
cells.note: This sentence is quoted from the wiki entry because the supplied study text does not include the corresponding result sentence. The negative correlation indicates that students with lower scores tended to demonstrate more Guttman errors.

cells.quote: The 2PL model’s RMSEA is 0.07 while the 3PL model’s RMSEA is 0.06. This suggests that guessing was a significant factor in many students’ responses on many items.
cells.note: The study compared IRT model fit using post-instruction responses from 3205 introductory astronomy students; the lower RMSEA supported using the 3PL model.
